写操作需要预览和明确确认。你可以拒绝本次授权；拒绝后将返回客户端。: Writes require a preview and explicit confirmation. You can deny this request and return to the client.

授权请求无效，请从客户端重新发起授权: Invalid authorization request. Start again from the client.
权限与风险分别控制可访问功能和 AI 可代执行的范围: Permissions control accessible capabilities; risk limits control what AI can execute.
模型服务、存储配置、令牌及个人敏感操作始终与 AI/MCP 写入口隔离。AI 的: Model services, storage settings, tokens and sensitive personal actions stay outside AI/MCP write access. AI changes are previewed in a plan and require your confirmation.

请从 MCP 客户端重新发起授权。: Start authorization again from your MCP client.
请返回 MCP 客户端重新发起授权。: Return to your MCP client and start authorization again.
你可以随时撤销已授权的客户端: You can revoke client access at any time
撤销后，该客户端的访问令牌和刷新令牌立即失效。所有调用仍受你当前的账号权限及风险: Revocation immediately invalidates the client’s access and refresh tokens. Every call remains subject to your current account permissions and risk limit.
撤销后需要在客户端重新发起授权才能继续访问。: The client will need a new authorization before it can access your account again.
读取当前账号有权访问的 MCP 功能及知识资源: Read MCP capabilities and knowledge available to your account

允许客户端通过轮换的刷新令牌保持授权，最长 30 天: Allow the client to retain access using rotating refresh tokens for up to 30 days
